An Opus gate checked rule-level items only (8 + 8, 0 overlap with census and probe text, near misses free of the declared trigger) and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Strongest activations are on tokens inside battery or galvanic-cell passages (lithium, Zn, Ag, mAh, battery, and function words like 'be' and 'an'), with a clear topic link; the + pole is the fuel-cell/hydrogen side, so fuel cells are used as a hard near miss. Weak activations on metals and code 'battery' keys suggest the topic label may only partly cover it.
